messages.text: You adding OS support for the Q1373 miner with 4 x 1373 chips?

Honest answer: I don't know whether a 4x BM1373 board is on the Harlo OS roadmap, and I won't guess at it. I've passed it to JD, who handles our firmware side.

The team is offline right now and picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET, with the answer by email, so what's the best address for you?

Release notes and current supported models live at https://harlolabs.com if you want to check in the meantime.
